topic: Malaysia: Japanese occupation in Malaya and its postwar political consequences
scope_decisions: The artifact set covers one topic only and stays within Malaya and its postwar political consequences.
No canonical recipes, generator code, docs, or unrelated recipe folders were modified.
PDF-facing prose stays in English, with only controlled Malay political terms where they clarify the history.
Exact casualty totals, precise ration quotas, and other unstable numeric claims are intentionally omitted.
decisions: The narrative centers on military rule, scarcity, resistance, the Malayan Union, the Federation of Malaya, and the Emergency.
The folder treats wartime resistance as a source of postwar political capital but does not try to write a full military history.
The topic boundary stops before later development history after independence.
